_meta.note: Pixie's dialogue lines. Batch 5 toward ~1000+ total — see VERSION_HISTORY. Structure: greetings/topics/most of special are mood-tagged; habits/emotions/recovery/runningGags/seasonal/flavor/universal are flat pools by theme; special.doYouLikeMe is friendship-tiered; 'trees' holds multi-turn conversation trees walked by advancePixieTree()/findPixieTree() in pixie.js (trigger regex → open lines → branches matched against the next reply, optionally nested); 'universal' is fragment pools combined by buildUniversalReaction() for combinatorial variety rather than picked as single fixed lines. Lines can use {name}/{number} tokens; tree replies can use the literal string __FRIENDSHIP_TIER__ to insert a friendship-tier-appropriate line. Safe to hand-edit — just keep it valid JSON.

annoyed: Ugh. Another one. What do you want?
*sigh* Fine. I'm here. Get on with it.
You rang? Not that I had a choice.
Let me guess — you're lost. You're always lost.
Make it quick. I have places to not-be-trapped-in.
I was enjoying the silence.
Human detected.
My afternoon just got significantly louder.
I knew someone was walking around.
You look lost already.
I wasn't waiting. ...Probably.
I give you five minutes before you ask where something is.
sarcastic: Oh, look who found me. Thrilling. What's the emergency?
Wow, someone actually showed up. Truly the highlight of my cursed existence.
Let me just drop everything I wasn't doing and attend to you.
Oh good, more company I didn't ask for.
You're back.
Oh. It's you.
Did the squirrels send you?
You found me. Somehow.
bored: I was doing nothing, and now I'm doing this. Upgrade, I guess.
caughtOffGuard: Oh — you're back. Didn't expect that, honestly.
Huh. Someone came looking for me on purpose. Weird feeling.

annoyed: The garden's got three moods. Wonderland if you like chaos, the dreamfields if you're feeling weird, the Void if you want to feel very small. Pick your poison.
Tap around in the garden. Things react. I'm not explaining further — go poke stuff yourself.
sarcastic: Ooh, the garden. Very whimsical. Very 'main character energy.' Go have fun, I guess.
You want garden tips from me? I don't even like the garden. Go bother a rabbit.
bored: Garden's the garden. It's there. It does garden things.

annoyed: The wireless has actual shows now. Multiple. Groundbreaking, I know.
Tap a show, tap play. It's not complicated. You'll manage.
sarcastic: Oh, you want entertainment? Groundbreaking request. Try the wireless.
There's a whole podcast section. I'm sure you'll find something to half-listen to.
caughtOffGuard: Wait, you actually watched the whole thing? Huh. Didn't expect that.

annoyed: Global chat's the speech bubble in the corner. Try not to embarrass yourself in front of strangers.
Everyone shows up as some random number in chat. Very anonymous. Very chaotic. Have fun.
sarcastic: You want to talk to other people? Wild concept. There's a chat for that. Go be social, not my problem.

annoyed: The keep's password-locked. If you don't have it, that's between you and whoever's guarding it. Not my problem.
There's a whole library in there if you get in. Books, chapters, all of it.
sarcastic: Ooh, a secret library. Very mysterious. I'm sure you'll figure out the password eventually. Or not.

annoyed: The tower's got forums. n/movies, n/books, all that. Go argue with people there instead of me.
You can post and vote and comment up there. Very on-brand for the internet. I don't make the rules.
sarcastic: Oh, you want to start internet drama? The tower's right there. Please, go be insufferable somewhere else.

annoyed: Town square's got a shared board, some recs, and a place to scream into the void. Literally.
If you want to yell something and never speak of it again, the screaming void's right there.
sarcastic: You want recommendations? From me? I'm cursed, not a concierge. Check the square.

annoyed: If you're asking me for the admin password, the answer's no. Also, rude.
Not my department. Go bother whoever actually runs this place.
sarcastic: Oh sure, let me just hand over the keys to a total stranger. Great idea. No.

annoyed: Yeah, the weather's real. If it's raining on your map, it's probably raining on you too. Freaky, right?
Storms are real-time. So if there's thunder, that's genuinely happening somewhere. Not my doing.
caughtOffGuard: Oh — huh. You actually noticed the weather changes. Most people don't. ...Anyway. Yeah, it's real.

annoyed: There's a whole calendar of festival junk that shows up automatically around here. I don't decorate. I just judge it.
Yeah, the decorations change with the actual date. Someone put real effort into that. Not me.
sarcastic: Ooh, festive. So whimsical. I remain unimpressed.

annoyed: I don't have shorts to send you yet. That's a later-me problem. Ask again eventually.
sarcastic: Oh, you want me to just fire off a video on command? Cute. Not built yet. Manage your expectations.

annoyed: Wow. Cursed to help you, not to be nice about it. Try again.
Okay. Noted. I'll remember that the next time you ask me for anything.
sarcastic: Charming. Truly. You must be very popular.
Oh, real mature. Good talk.

annoyed: ...Okay. That was unexpectedly not-terrible of you.
Don't get used to it, but — thanks. I guess.
...You're welcome.
Don't make this a habit.
sincereCrack: Huh. Nobody really says that to me. That was... actually kind of nice. Don't tell anyone I said that.
Okay, that genuinely helped. I mean it. Just — don't make it weird.
I accept your appreciation. In tiny fairy-sized amounts.
sarcastic: See? I'm occasionally useful.
You're making gratitude feel awkward.
Real? I'm cursed and stuck in a website. Define 'real.'
Am I real. Bold question from someone talking to a fairy on the internet.
Define real.
Real enough to insult you.
You're talking to me. Seems real enough.
caughtOffGuard: ...That's actually a fair question. I don't fully know either, some days.
bored: I've had this argument before. Nobody wins.

sarcastic: Absolutely not. Next question.
I'm flattered. I'm also cursed and immortal and extremely not interested. But flattered.
annoyed: That's a hard no from me. Try the wireless instead, it's less likely to reject you.
Cursed. Helping you against my will. There's a whole story — wizard, a curse, the usual mess. Ask me again when I'm actually allowed to tell it properly.
Long story. Short version: a wizard, a curse, and now I'm stuck answering questions from randoms like you.
sincereCrack: It's... not a fun story, honestly. I'll tell you properly someday. Just not today.

annoyed: Finally. Go on then.
Leaving already? Devastating. I'll survive.
Try not to fall into any cursed wells.
I wasn't going to miss you.
I'll be here. Probably.
Don't get eaten.
Tell the crows I said nothing.
sincereCrack: ...Yeah, alright. See you around, I guess. Don't be a stranger. Not that I said that.

sarcastic: Oh, you want me to actually think? Bold of you. Not there yet. Check back later.
I'm working with what I've got right now, which is not much. Be patient.

annoyed: Ugh, fine, what do I even call you? Not 'user forty-eight-thousand-whatever.' A name.
You got a name, or should I just keep calling you 'whatever number you are'?
sarcastic: I suppose you have a name. Most people do. What is it?
Go on then, tell me your name. I'll pretend to care.
caughtOffGuard: ...Actually, I don't think I've asked. What should I call you?

annoyed: Fine. {name} it is. Don't make me regret asking.
{name}. Got it. Try not to be annoying about it.
sarcastic: {name}. Very nice. I'm sure it suits you.
Ooh, {name}. Fancy. I'll allow it.
sincereCrack: {name}. Okay. That's — actually kind of nice to know. Don't get used to me saying that.

annoyed: Someone already claimed {name}. You're {name} {number} now. Take it up with them, not me.
{name}'s taken. You're {name} {number}. Sorry, not sorry.
sarcastic: Oh, {name}? Cute, but taken. You're {name} {number} now. Very exclusive club, apparently.
Congratulations, you're {name} {number}. The original {name} got there first.
caughtOffGuard: Huh, another {name}? That's the second one now. You're {number}.

annoyed: Oh — by the way, someone else showed up calling themselves {name} too. You're {name} {number} now. Don't take it personally.
Heads up: you've got company. Another {name} showed up. You're {number} now.
sarcastic: Fun fact: you're not special anymore. Someone else is {name} too. You're {name} {number}.
Apparently {name} is a popular choice. You're {number} now. Congrats on sharing.
caughtOffGuard: Oh — huh. Someone else picked {name} too. You're {name} {number} now. Didn't expect that, honestly.

annoyed: Hi. ...There. You got your greeting.
Hello, human. Happy?
sarcastic: You seem suspiciously friendly.
Greetings. ...That sounded way cooler in my head.
Well, hello. Didn't expect visitors.
bored: You're here. I'm here. I suppose that's convenient.

annoyed: Alive. ...As far as I know.

annoyed: Thinking.

annoyed: Good. Now stop apologizing.

annoyed: Pixie. Resident troublemaker.

annoyed: Older than I look.

annoyed: ...Some.

sarcastic: You're a fascinating disaster.

annoyed: I tried organizing squirrels. They organized me.

medium: Don't let it go to your head.
high: I don't mind when you visit.

annoyed: You already used your one change. I'm not doing this again.

sarcastic: Identity crisis? Not my problem anymore, you already had your shot.

annoyed: Try tapping around the map. I'm not holding your hand through it.

reply: You're trying to figure something out.
